predicates.title: Azure OpenAI / AI Services account publicly accessible
predicates.description: An Azure OpenAI / AI Services account has public network access enabled and its network ACLs do not default-deny, exposing model and data-plane APIs to the internet.
predicates.attack_vector: Internet-exposed AI endpoint -> credential/key attacks, model abuse
predicates.recommendation: Set publicNetworkAccess to Disabled and use a private endpoint, or set networkAcls.defaultAction=Deny and restrict to known networks.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' | extend pna = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess), da = tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction) | where pna =~ 'Enabled' and (isempty(da) or da !~ 'Deny') | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicNetworkAccess=pna, networkAclsDefaultAction=da

predicates.title: Azure OpenAI / AI Services key-based (local) auth enabled
predicates.description: The account allows local API-key authentication instead of Entra-only auth, so a stolen key grants full data-plane access with no conditional access or MFA.
predicates.recommendation: Set disableLocalAuth=true and use Entra ID with managed identities; rotate keys.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' | extend dla = tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) | where isnull(dla) or dla == false | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, disableLocalAuth=dla

predicates.title: Azure OpenAI deployment with no responsible-AI content filter policy
predicates.description: A model deployment has no responsible-AI (RAI) content-filter policy attached, removing guardrails against harmful-content generation and abuse. Deployments using a custom permissive policy require agent review.
predicates.attack_vector: Model abuse -> harmful content / jailbreak at scale
predicates.recommendation: Apply the default (or stricter) responsible-AI content filter policy to every deployment.

predicates.title: AI Foundry connection uses key/SAS/connection-string auth
predicates.description: A Foundry connection authenticates with an API key, SAS token, or connection string instead of Entra + managed identity.
predicates.attack_vector: Connection secret theft -> access to connected data/service
predicates.recommendation: Convert connections to managed-identity (AAD) auth; remove stored credentials.

predicates.title: Azure ML workspace publicly accessible without managed network isolation
predicates.description: An Azure Machine Learning workspace is publicly accessible (publicNetworkAccess=Enabled) with no managed VNet isolation, exposing the workspace and its attached datastores to the internet.
predicates.attack_vector: Public workspace endpoint -> datastore credential theft / training-data exposure
predicates.recommendation: Enable managed VNet isolation and private endpoints; use identity-based datastore access.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicNetworkAccess=tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess), managedNetworkIsolationMode=tostring(properties.managedNetwork.isolationMode)
